lines = [
'Sub Del_Blanks()',
'Dim LR As Long',
'LR = Range(\"A\" & Rows.Count).End(xlUp).Row',
'Range(\"A4:A\" & LR).AutoFilter Field:=1, Criteria1:=\"=\"',
'Range(\"A4:A\" & LR).SpecialCells(xlCellTypeVisible).EntireRow.Delete',
'Range(\"A4:A\" & LR).AutoFilter',
'End Sub',
]
for i, line in enumerate(lines):
    ws.cell(3+i, 1).value = line
wb.save('output.xlsx')
print('done')
"
